text: Please note function's logic currently based onNorth America . function adjusts dataframe visit events (e.g., feed water visits) based DST changes. detects whether current date DST transition day (spring fall), day spring DST change, applies appropriate time correction logic. adjustment logic case follows:

title: Adjust Time Stamp for Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transitions in North America — daylight_saving_adjust
text: data_frame data frame two columns representing start end time visit, formatted "HH:MM:SS". date string "YYYY-MM-DD" format Date object. start_col Name column recording start time event (quoted), e.g.: start_col = "start" end_col Name column recording end time event (quoted). e.g.: end_col = "end" dst_df data frame created get_dst_switch_info, containing DST change dates times year. daylight_change_duration many minutes clock jump fall back day daylight saving change? integer duration minutes (default = 60). tz valid time zone name (default time zone current physical location), used determine DST rules. Use OlsonNames() see valid options.

title: Adjust Time Stamp for Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transitions in North America — daylight_saving_adjust
text: data frame adjusted daylight saving time, original data adjustment applies.

title: Adjust Time Stamp for Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transitions in North America — daylight_saving_adjust
text: Fall DST Change Day (e.g., 1st Sunday November): North American clocks fall back 2:00 1:00 , repeating hour 1:00 2:00 . sensors repeat 1–2 hour instead continue recording 2–3 time never changed. function: Removes visits occur ambiguous hour (2:00 –3:00 , recorded). Shifts visits 3:00 back 1 hour align post-fallback clock time. Spring DST Change Day (e.g., 2nd Sunday March): North American clocks spring jump forward 2:00 3:00 , skipping hour 2–3 . sensors continue recording local time, resulting inconsistent timestamps. function: Removes visits start DST jump (2:00 ) end skipped hour (2:00–3:00 ). Shifts visits occur 2:00 forward 1 hour align new clock time. Day Spring DST Change: day spring DST change, sensors may still include late-night entries previous (DST) day, due time "-spill" function: Identifies first time point time resets, based start time column. Removes rows entries previous day data spillover due DST change.

title: Adjust Time Stamp for Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transitions in North America — daylight_saving_adjust
code: dst_info <- get_dst_switch_info(years = 2021, tz = "America/Vancouver") df <- data.frame(Start = c("01:30:00", "02:30:00", "04:00:00"),                  End = c("02:00:00", "03:00:00", "04:30:00")) print(df) #>      Start      End #> 1 01:30:00 02:00:00 #> 2 02:30:00 03:00:00 #> 3 04:00:00 04:30:00 daylight_saving_adjust(df,                       date = "2021-11-07",                       start_col = "Start",                       end_col = "End",                       dst_df = dst_info,                       tz = "America/Vancouver") #>      Start       End #> 1 3H 0M 0S 3H 30M 0S
